# Generated — do not edit

Every `.js` file here is built from `server/` by `scripts/build-functions.mjs`.

Vercel's Node builder transpiles TypeScript routes but does **not** bundle them,
so relative import specifiers survive into the deployed output and fail to
resolve at runtime (`Cannot find module '/var/task/api/_lib/session.ts'`).
Pre-bundling each route removes every relative import.

The output is committed as well as regenerated by the build command, so the
functions are present whether Vercel scans for them before or after the build.
Edit `server/`, then run `npm run build:functions`.
